checks_without_high_medium_issue: Read path calls prepare_pair/validate_decision and literal fallback only; no HTTP/judge/model call in results or rank.
Fingerprint includes point identity, exact skill strings, unit technology, student stage, resource identity/canonical, proof fields and raw source/own projection hashes.
Eight mutations of point/skill/tool/stage/resource/raw source/canonical/provenance correctly reject a saved old decision.
ReadRankCache hashes complete point/resource/observed/eligibility/request and deepcopies results; no DB connection or mutable raw input retained as cache key.
Course/playlist media requires same-page video identity plus bound own catalog; FCC/TWT require their own strict scoped adapters, not Article or directory fallback.
Calls capped by settings validation at 0..2 per job; source payload/output/pairs/quotes bounded, outer job deadline wraps execution; cancellation propagates.
Canonical URL handling correctly normalizes observed Bili uid query parameters; a retained genuine CSV video remains admissible.
limits: This is not real semantic model accuracy validation. Synthetic plausible bad verdicts test local hard boundaries only.
